rows.definition: WorktreeCandidate (internal/dojocal/worktree.go) is the single (lever, metric) recalibration the dojocal worktree arm measures: the cell to re-point plus the corpus-mean claim to swap in, built from the worst RECALIBRATE of `fak dojo-rsi propose` and carried as the Payload of a rsiloop.Candidate.
rows.distinction: The dojocal recalibration PAYLOAD measured inside one worktree arm - NOT rsiloop (the generic keep-or-revert loop that measures it) and NOT GenerationCandidate/ReviewCandidate (issue-planning candidates in the plan family, which propose issues to open, not RSI cells to re-point).
